violated_contract: A value a wearable reports over BLE is a firmware-side estimate with known failure modes per firmware line (a battery filter that freezes while charging or refuses increases until restart). The app must not present it as ground truth: a reading that contradicts what the app observed (a long charge, an unchanged near-empty value, a first pairing) must be withheld or qualified on every surface that renders it, while gating and telemetry keep the raw value.
canonical_prevention: Route every user-facing rendering of a device-reported value through one plausibility policy owned by the device provider, keep the raw value for gating and diagnostics, test each known firmware failure mode as a policy case, and report how often the policy withholds a value.
